mono.usage: Data points, script timestamps, technical details

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (p-8, p-12, p-24) to create cinematic breathing room.
layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C99A2E] text-black font-medium hover:bg-[#DBC075] transition-all rounded-full px-8 py-3
buttons.glass: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/20 rounded-full px-8 py-3

cards.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-b border-white/5

landing.hero: Cinematic full-bleed background image with heavy dark gradient overlay (bg-black/60). Asymmetrical typography layout. The main headline should be massive using Playfair Display.
landing.how_it_works: Bento grid (Mode A: Tetris Grid) showing the 4 steps with glowing borders (The 'Tracing Beam' effect).
landing.presenter_preview: Horizontal scrolling marquee of AI presenters.

dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Sidebar navigation with glassmorphism. Dense data presentation using JetBrains Mono for metrics.

ai_studio.layout: Two-column split view. Left: Property input form. Right: Editable script preview with glassmorphic tools overlay.

recorder.ui: Immersive dark mode. Teleprompter text in center, camera feed as background with blur, prominent red record button.

pricing.layout: 3-tier card layout. Pro tier highlighted with gold glow (`shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(201,154,46,0.3)]`).

images.description: Modern house with large windows at dusk. Use as the main cinematic hero background with a dark overlay.
Castle-like mansion. Use for secondary feature sections or concierge background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: yarn add @fontsource/playfair-display @fontsource/outfit @fontsource/jetbrains-mono lucide-react framer-motion react-fast-marquee
Use standard HTML tags and Tailwind for Landing/Marketing pages to ensure maximum creativity and asymmetrical bento grids. Do not rely heavily on strict Card components here.
Use Shadcn UI components (Tabs, Dialog, Select, Dropdown, Tables) for the Dashboard, AI Studio, Recorder, and Settings to ensure high functionality.
Implement the 'Crystal Glass' effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10) for floating headers, floating action bars, and modal overlays.
Headings must use 'font-serif' (Playfair Display) to convey luxury, while body text uses 'font-sans' (Outfit) for legibility. DO NOT use Inter.
Ensure all interactive elements and key text elements include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='pricing-pro-tier-button').
Never use pure black or pure gray. Use #050505 for the absolute background to add an expensive, moody cinematic depth.
Primary CTA buttons must be Gold (#C99A2E) with black text. Avoid using gold for large background areas; keep it restricted to accents and buttons.
For the Recorder UI, create an immersive view with absolute positioning, blurring the background, and placing teleprompter text prominently over the 'camera' feed view.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure gold text on dark backgrounds meets WCAG AA guidelines. When using gold on light glassmorphism, adjust opacity for legibility.
